utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, what exactly still needs fixing, and who have you already got signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We still need help with the fence, a leaky gutter, and the broken step by the front porch. So far, Sam and Lila said they’d come by, and I’m trying to get one more person.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. When are Sam and Lila coming, and do you want me to ask anyone else?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help out with the repair drive, Noah. If you need any tools or a hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — I might take you up on that. I’m still figuring out what all needs fixing, but I’ll holler if I’m short on tools or hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list, and I can bring over whatever tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are bringing in all kinds of broken odds and ends to get fixed up. It should be a nice little community thing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds nice, but I hope they’ve got enough tables and tools for everything. If too many people show up at once, it could get a bit messy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you're right, Pia—I'll ask around and see if they're still looking for extra folding tables or tool kits before the day gets away from us.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you help me track which homes still need a pickup and which ones are already covered?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — send me the list of homes, and I’ll mark which ones still need a pickup and which ones are already covered.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m glad I caught you—there’s a repair drive coming up, and I’m telling everyone on the block so we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, that sounds useful. I’m not sure how much I can help, but I can take a flyer if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ve got a flyer right here for you. And please pass it along if anyone else on the block might want to come!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m getting the repair drive organized now—can you tell me what’s broken and when you’re free to help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Rosa — my porch light is out and the back gate sticks. I’m free Thursday evening or Saturday morning to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I’ll put your porch light and back gate on the list, and Saturday morning would be perfect if you can help then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what details do you want me to double-check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you double-check the start time and what tools we should bring? I usually end up joining late, so I want to make sure I’m set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely, I’ll confirm the start time and the tool list before you head over, so you’re not guessing if you arrive late.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive timing first. What day are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m thinking Saturday would work best, maybe late morning into early afternoon so families can swing by after errands. Does that fit around the school schedule for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday late morning should work for me. If we can keep it to early afternoon, I can make it fit around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming together, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest from your side?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s moving along nicely — we’ve got a few volunteers lined up and people are dropping off tools and supplies. I can fill you in on the needs list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please — I’d love the needs list. I’m still catching up, so even the basics would help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I saw something about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not totally sure yet—can you confirm whether the repair drive is actually happening this Saturday, and what kinds of items they’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ll double-check the notice and ask around—Saturday and the accepted items, got it. I’ll let you know once I have the actual details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still catching up on the repair drive. What do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I keep losing track. Mostly just bring whatever tools you’ve got, and I’ll point you to the stuff that still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring what tools I have and check in with you when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up—do you know the plan yet? I can help spread the word once I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still gathering the supply count, but the plan is to set up a repair table at the community room this weekend. Once I confirm the time and what tools we’re short on, I’ll pass you the details to share.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll wait for the confirmed time and tool list, then I can spread the word about the community room repair table this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I’m just catching up while I’m out—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not fully caught up yet, Ira—I’ve only heard bits from a couple neighbors. If I learn anything definite, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey—no rush. I’ll keep my ears open while I’m out too, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I keep forgetting the details, but I’m happy to help if you need me to bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll ask around and repeat the plan once I’ve got the details straight, so you’ll know exactly what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be perfect, Vik—if you tell me twice, I might even remember it once. I’ll keep myself free to help when you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I was meaning to check that out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nice, it’s this Saturday सुबह—I'll send the address and a quick list of what they need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, this Saturday morning—thanks. Send me the address and list when you can, and I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I heard you’re organizing the repair drive—if you need extra tools or a spare pair of hands, I’m happy to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’ll make a simple list and let you know exactly what we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli—just give me a shout when the list’s ready, and I’ll see what I can bring from my garage.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn, I’m glad we’re talking about the repair drive—what still needs lining up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Mara! We still need a few more repair volunteers, a table setup, and someone to spread the word—I can start inviting folks on our block right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Quinn—thank you for taking on the block invites. I can help line up the table setup and ask around for a couple more repair volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together — it’s nice seeing everyone pitch in. If you need another pair of hands, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll mark you down as available and let you know exactly where we need you once the stations are set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — just point me where you need me, and I’ll be there. I’m happy to help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m pulling the repair drive details together now, and I’d love your help with the list. If you’re free, we can sort out what needs attention first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa, I’m free to help. Let’s start by listing the urgent repairs and what supplies we already have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Cleo — let’s put safety issues first, like loose railings, bad lighting, or leaks, then we’ll match each one with any supplies already in the closet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive from other folks—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still gathering the details, Nell. Do you know if they’ve set a date and what kinds of repairs they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard a date yet, just that folks are talking about basic home repairs and small fixes. I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sorry, I missed the details — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help organize the sign-up and pickup times for the repair drive? I’m juggling school drop-off, so having a clear schedule would really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can put together a simple sign-up and pickup schedule. Send me the time windows and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I’m glad you’re organizing the repair drive—how can I pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I appreciate that, Sam, but can you confirm what tools or skills you can actually bring before I put you on the list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring a cordless drill, a basic wrench set, and I’m comfortable with simple patching and furniture assembly.
